See a minimalist chart and quotes for your chosen ticker.</p><a href="/widget-docs/widgets/charts/symbol-overview/" target="_blank" class="button-peb2LdGo button-KoxY3d86 large-KoxY3d86 gray-KoxY3d86 primary-KoxY3d86 link-KoxY3d86 apply-overflow-tooltip apply-overflow-tooltip--check-children-recursively apply-overflow-tooltip--allow-text apply-common-tooltip"><span class="content-KoxY3d86">Get the widget</span></a></div><div class="widget-peb2LdGo"><div class="imageContainer-peb2LdGo"><img src="https://static.tradingview.com/static/bundles/advanced-chart-widget.6fcbfb7bc99cd5436cad.jpg" class="image-peb2LdGo" alt=""></div><p class="title-peb2LdGo">Advanced Chart Widget</p><p class="description-peb2LdGo">Need more firepower? This is one of our most powerful integrable tools.</p><a href="/widget-docs/widgets/charts/advanced-chart/" target="_blank" class="button-peb2LdGo button-KoxY3d86 large-KoxY3d86 gray-KoxY3d86 primary-KoxY3d86 link-KoxY3d86 apply-overflow-tooltip apply-overflow-tooltip--check-children-recursively apply-overflow-tooltip--allow-text apply-common-tooltip"><span class="content-KoxY3d86">Get the widget</span></a></div></div></div><div class="faqWrapper-FL8wg06b"><div class="faq-FL8wg06b"><div class="header-FL8wg06b wrap-kXOWFqJu"><h2 class="promo-header-h2-kXOWFqJu"><p class="title-kXOWFqJu center-kXOWFqJu title-FL8wg06b"><span> <!-- -->Frequently asked<!-- --> </span><span class="lastWord-kXOWFqJu">questions</span></p></h2></div><div class="faqList-FL8wg06b"><div class="wrapper-mGLyum4Y"><div class="column-mGLyum4Y"><div class="item-CB10Nqp7 large-CB10Nqp7" style="order:0"><button class="summary-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-summary::Rmu:" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="Accordion-details::Rmu:"><div class="summaryLine-CB10Nqp7"><span class="background-CB10Nqp7"></span><div class="summaryText-CB10Nqp7">What's the difference between widgets and libraries?</div><div role="presentation"><div class="wrapper-QvjxDSJu large-QvjxDSJu"><div class="horizontal-QvjxDSJu"></div><div class="vertical-QvjxDSJu"></div></div></div></div></button><div class="detailsWrapper-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-details::Rmu:" inert=""><div class="details-CB10Nqp7"><p>Both are charting solutions to display data. Widgets are embeddable iframe objects that TradingView hosts. They contain data from TradingView and can be included in your site or app by copypasting a simple configurable script. Libraries, on the other hand, are more customizable, feature-rich components that you host on your servers, and connect your data to them through the API.</p></div></div></div><div class="item-CB10Nqp7 large-CB10Nqp7" style="order:1"><button class="summary-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-summary::R16u:" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="Accordion-details::R16u:"><div class="summaryLine-CB10Nqp7"><span class="background-CB10Nqp7"></span><div class="summaryText-CB10Nqp7">What's the main difference between the Advanced Charts and the Trading Platform libraries?</div><div role="presentation"><div class="wrapper-QvjxDSJu large-QvjxDSJu"><div class="horizontal-QvjxDSJu"></div><div class="vertical-QvjxDSJu"></div></div></div></div></button><div class="detailsWrapper-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-details::R16u:" inert=""><div class="details-CB10Nqp7"><p>Our Advanced Chart library is a free, standalone solution that you can host on your own servers, even plug your own data into, plus integrate with your website and app. The Trading Platform library contains everything from Advanced Charts, and also has direct trading functionality.</p></div></div></div><div class="item-CB10Nqp7 large-CB10Nqp7" style="order:2"><button class="summary-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-summary::R1mu:" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="Accordion-details::R1mu:"><div class="summaryLine-CB10Nqp7"><span class="background-CB10Nqp7"></span><div class="summaryText-CB10Nqp7">Can I get a library for personal use?</div><div role="presentation"><div class="wrapper-QvjxDSJu large-QvjxDSJu"><div class="horizontal-QvjxDSJu"></div><div class="vertical-QvjxDSJu"></div></div></div></div></button><div class="detailsWrapper-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-details::R1mu:" inert=""><div class="details-CB10Nqp7"><p>At this time, we don't provide the Advanced Charts and the Trading Platform libraries for personal use, hobbies, studies, or testing. These licenses are only available to companies for use in public web projects and/or applications. However, you can use the Lightweight Charts™ for personal projects — it's open-source under the Apache 2.0 license.</p></div></div></div><div class="item-CB10Nqp7 large-CB10Nqp7" style="order:3"><button class="summary-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-summary::R26u:" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="Accordion-details::R26u:"><div class="summaryLine-CB10Nqp7"><span class="background-CB10Nqp7"></span><div class="summaryText-CB10Nqp7">What do I need to know before applying for the Trading Platform library?</div><div role="presentation"><div class="wrapper-QvjxDSJu large-QvjxDSJu"><div class="horizontal-QvjxDSJu"></div><div class="vertical-QvjxDSJu"></div></div></div></div></button><div class="detailsWrapper-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-details::R26u:" inert=""><div class="details-CB10Nqp7"><p>The library should be connected to the broker's back-end, including both the data stream and order management (routing) system. This setup lets users trade right from the chart, and all you have to do to make this work is to implement your Broker API and plug it into the chart widget. Datafeed must be enabled to support real-time pricing data.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="column-mGLyum4Y"><div class="item-CB10Nqp7 large-CB10Nqp7" style="order:4"><button class="summary-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-summary::Rqu:" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="Accordion-details::Rqu:"><div class="summaryLine-CB10Nqp7"><span class="background-CB10Nqp7"></span><div class="summaryText-CB10Nqp7">What do I need to start implementing the Advanced Charts?</div><div role="presentation"><div class="wrapper-QvjxDSJu large-QvjxDSJu"><div class="horizontal-QvjxDSJu"></div><div class="vertical-QvjxDSJu"></div></div></div></div></button><div class="detailsWrapper-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-details::Rqu:" inert=""><div class="details-CB10Nqp7"><p>Advanced Charts should be integrated by technical specialists. This library requires advanced skills in JavaScript and an understanding of WEB protocols.</p></div></div></div><div class="item-CB10Nqp7 large-CB10Nqp7" style="order:5"><button class="summary-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-summary::R1au:" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="Accordion-details::R1au:"><div class="summaryLine-CB10Nqp7"><span class="background-CB10Nqp7"></span><div class="summaryText-CB10Nqp7">Will I get the source code for the libraries?</div><div role="presentation"><div class="wrapper-QvjxDSJu large-QvjxDSJu"><div class="horizontal-QvjxDSJu"></div><div class="vertical-QvjxDSJu"></div></div></div></div></button><div class="detailsWrapper-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-details::R1au:" inert=""><div class="details-CB10Nqp7"><p><span class="disableRtl-sNZNSJj6">Lightweight Charts™</span> are open-source under the Apache 2.0 license. For other charting solutions, our source code is not provided.</p></div></div></div><div class="item-CB10Nqp7 large-CB10Nqp7 isLast-CB10Nqp7" style="order:6"><button class="summary-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-summary::R1qu:" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="Accordion-details::R1qu:"><div class="summaryLine-CB10Nqp7"><span class="background-CB10Nqp7"></span><div class="summaryText-CB10Nqp7">Where do I get technical support?</div><div role="presentation"><div class="wrapper-QvjxDSJu large-QvjxDSJu"><div class="horizontal-QvjxDSJu"></div><div class="vertical-QvjxDSJu"></div></div></div></div></button><div class="detailsWrapper-CB10Nqp7" id="Accordion-details::R1qu:" inert=""><div class="details-CB10Nqp7"><p>Documentation, bug trackers, and examples of charting libraries are on <a target="_blank" href="https://github.com/tradingview/" rel="nofollow">Github</a>, accessible once you have access to the specific library repository. You can also check out our <a class="link-sNZNSJj6" href="/charting-library-docs/latest/getting_started/Frequently-Asked-Questions/">FAQ section</a>. If you need more help, reach out to <a href="mailto:platforms@tradingview.com">platforms@tradingview.com</a></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
